functions.name: ForEachReplicationSystem
functions.docs: Call a function on all ReplicationSystems of a specific world.

functions.name: ForEachReplicationSystem
functions.docs: Call a function on all existing ReplicationSystems. This could include systems from other clients (e.g. PIE worlds)

functions.name: GetReplicationSystem
functions.docs: Returns the UReplicationSystem for the main NetDriver assigned to the Actor. Note that an Actor may be replicated by multiple ReplicationSystems. May return null.

functions.name: GetReplicationSystem
functions.docs: Returns the UReplicationSystem for a specific NetDriver. May return null.

functions.name: GetReplicationSystem
functions.docs: Returns the UReplicationSystem for the main NetDriver of this World. May return null.

functions.name: GetActorReplicationBridge
functions.docs: Returns the UEngineReplicationBridge of the UReplicationSystem belonging to the main NetDriver assigned to the Actor. May return null.

functions.name: GetActorReplicationBridge
functions.docs: Returns the UReplicationSystem of the UNetDriver the UNetConnection belongs to.

functions.name: GetEngineReplicationBridge
functions.docs: Returns the UEngineReplicationBridge of the UReplicationSystem belonging to the main NetDriver of this World. May return null.

functions.name: GetNetHandle
functions.docs: Returns the NetHandle for any replicated object. The returned handle may be invalid.

functions.name: BeginReplication
functions.docs: Begins replication of an actor and all of its registered subobjects. If any ReplicationSystem wants to replicate the actor a NetHandle will be created.

functions.name: BeginReplication
functions.docs: Begins replication of an actor and all of its registered subobjects. If any ReplicationSystem wants to replicate the actor a NetHandle will be created.

functions.name: EndReplication
functions.docs: Stop replicating an actor. Will destroy handle for actor and registered subobjects.

functions.name: BeginReplicationForActorComponent
functions.docs: Create NetHandle for actor component and add it as a subobject to the actor handle.

functions.name: BeginReplicationForActorComponent
functions.docs: Create NetHandle for actor component and add it as a subobject to the actor.

functions.name: EndReplicationForActorComponent
functions.docs: Stop replicating an ActorComponent and its associated SubObjects.

functions.name: BeginReplicationForActorSubObject
functions.docs: Create NetHandle for SubObject and add it as a subobject to the actor.

functions.name: EndReplicationForActorSubObject
functions.docs: Stop replicating a SubObject ActorComponent and its associated SubObjects.

functions.name: BeginReplicationForActorComponentSubObject
functions.docs: Create NetHandle for SubObject and add it as a subobject to the actor component, but only replicated if the ActorComponent replicates.

functions.name: EndReplicationForActorComponentSubObject
functions.docs: Stop replicating an ActorComponent and its associated SubObjects.

functions.name: SetNetConditionForActorSubObject
SetNetConditionForActorComponent
UpdateSubObjectGroupMemberships
functions.docs: Update group memberships used by COND_Group sub object filtering for the specified SubObject

functions.name: UpdateSubObjectGroupMemberships
functions.docs: Update replication status for all NetGroups used by COND_Group sub object filtering for the provided PlayerController

functions.name: RemoveSubObjectGroupMembership
functions.docs: Update replication status for the PlayerController to not include the specified NetGroup

functions.name: AddDependentActor
RemoveDependentActor
functions.docs: Remove dependent actor from parent. The dependent actor will function as a standard standalone replicated actor.

functions.name: BeginReplicationForActorsInWorldForNetDriver
functions.docs: Begin replication for all networked actors that belong to a specific driver in the world.

functions.name: NotifyActorDormancyChange
functions.signature: NotifyActorDormancyChange(Replication System, Actor, Old Dormancy State)
functions.docs: Notify the ReplicationSystem of a dormancy change.

functions.name: FlushNetDormancy
functions.signature: FlushNetDormancy(Replication System, Actor, Was Dorm Initial)
functions.docs: Trigger replication of dirty state for actor wanting to be dormant.

functions.name: SetReplicationCondition
functions.docs: Enable or disable a replication condition. This will affect the replication of properties with conditions.

functions.name: SetStaticPriority
functions.docs:
Sets a fixed priority for a replicated object
@see ReplicationSystem.h for details

functions.name: SetCullDistanceOverride
functions.docs: Set the cull distance for an actor. This will cause affected code to ignore the NetCullDistanceSquared property.

functions.name: ClearCullDistanceOverride
functions.docs: Clears any previously set cull distance override for an actor. This will cause affected code to respect the NetCullDistanceSquared property.

functions.name: SetPollFrequency
functions.docs: Set the poll frequency for an object and its subobjects.
